description: This file contains implementation of PMA (Programmable Memory Attribute) initialization for RISC-V Andes V5 architecture within Zephyr RTOS, including CSR register manipulations, region validation, and configuration functions.

methods.name: write_pmaaddr_csr
methods.description: Writes a value to the CSR pmaaddr register at a specified index.

methods.name: write_pmacfg_entry
methods.description: Writes a configuration entry to the packed pmacfg CSR registers.

methods.name: region_init
methods.description: Initializes a PMA region with specified start, size, and attributes.

methods.name: pma_region_is_valid
methods.description: Performs runtime validation of a PMA region’s start address and size.

methods.name: configure_nocache_region
methods.description: Configures a non-cacheable PMA region if enabled.

methods.name: pma_init
methods.description: Initializes PMA CSRs for each CPU core, checks support, and calls core-specific init.

methods.name: pma_init_per_core
methods.description: Configures PMA regions for the current CPU core, including nocache region if enabled.
